title: Antigua Blue | 30a Condo Rental | 30a Beach Properties – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: A 1-bed rental featuring stunning gulf views, Antigua Blue is a newly rennovated condo perfect for your next vacation! Click here to learn more today.
description_expanded:
30a Beach Properties presents our newly renovated contemporary beach suite. The stunning Gulf View overlooking the Western Green is impressively matched by the ultra-modern interiors. The kitchen features Sub-Zero and European kitchen brands. Brand New all marble bathroom just completed for 2025. Comfortable seating with a big screen TV to relax. Sights and sounds from this Main Street setting in the heart of the Rosemary Beach village. Large front and rear balconies with all new furniture offer several areas to relax and take in the Gulf air. A wonderfully sophisticated vacation awaits at the Antigua Blue!

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

Features:

1 King Bed in Master.

1 Twin Pullout sofa in living room

Dedicated bathroom makeup counter with illuminated mirror

Modern Full Kitchen with Quartz Countertops

2 Tommy Bahama Carry Beach Chairs Included. (Located on Rear Balcony)

Hidden pullout Coffee bar with Keurig and Drip Machine

Bikes available on request at a premium rate

Large front balcony overlooking Main St

Private rear patio with lounge chairs, dining table and fountain.

Smart TV's with SONOS soundbars
